crediting_period.quote: The project was commenced on January 1, 2005. Since this time, Wildlife Works has been successfully protecting Rukinga Ranch from agricultural encroachment (deforestation), wildlife poaching and forest degradation. The Phase I Project is 30 years in length. The project will therefore end on December 31, 2035.
